info.title: Sluiceway app, for the command line
info.description: The Sluiceway app for `npx sluiceway` and its agents. Every request carries a personal token, made on the person's own page in the app, in `Authorization: Bearer <token>`; a cookie never works here. A token is for one org, and every answer counts as its person, by the same rules as the app's pages. Stack-level facts only: never a resource name, a property path or a value.

get.summary: Who the token is, its org, and until when it works.

401.description: No token, or one that does not work.

403.description: The token's person no longer belongs to the org, or the app left it.

404.description: Not the token's org, or nothing there the pages would open.

429.description: The token's rate limit is spent. Retry-After says when.

503.description: GitHub did not say whether the person still belongs to the org.

token.description: A personal token, made on the person's own page in the app (Tokens), for one org, for 30, 90 or 365 days. It starts sluiceway_.

Error.description: Every answer that is not a success.

problems.description: One sentence per change that was refused.

state.description: The app's five states: queued is deploying, drift is drifted, preview failed is failed.

word.description: The dashboard's own word: queued, preview failed, in sync…

destroys.description: A pending stack that deletes or replaces resources.

line.description: The row's one line of meaning, as the org view says it.

anyOf.description: While the repo's sluiceway.yaml does not name sluiceway[bot] in recordWriters.

page.description: The org's page in the app.

locked.description: The adopted repos past the free allowance: their name and state counts only.

anyOf.description: in the app, or via the command line: where the tick was asked.

result.description: In the trail's words: waiting to start, deploying now, went out, failed, no changes, drift fixed, drift gone, rehearsed, destroyed.

state.description: The app's five states: queued is deploying, drift is drifted, preview failed is failed.

anyOf.description: 1 update, 1 replace: the row's counts in its words.
What the row deletes or replaces.
The stack's preview page: the check run of this name on the scanned commit, which the commit's checks list.

asked.description: A rescan asked in the app or through the command line, and a pull request the command line opened.

outcome.description: asked: the record is open and GitHub and the runner decide the rest; github: the tick happens on the dashboard on GitHub.

keys.description: Every key a change may name, with the value the file gives it.

KeyChange.description: A documented key of sluiceway.yaml that edit mode changes: dashboard.title, dashboard.redact, dashboard.sections, drift.enabled, tickers, recordWriters (true names sluiceway[bot]), ignore, stacks[<stack id>].deploy, stacks[<stack id>].tickers, and the rest the config route lists. null puts the action's default back.
